title: Daande Deƴƴere
intro: Oo neɗɗo ina siftoree e hakkille luggiɗiiɗo e ardaade, rokka wasiyaaji ɓurɗi yontaaji. Haala maɓɓe ko seedantaagal dewal e nafoore anndude barkeeji e jarribooji ummoraade e Alla. Uddit sifaa oo yonta tedduɗo.
clues: Mi wonaano annabi, kono hakkille am ina maaynaa e Binndi Alla.
Wasiya am e ɓiɗɗo am teeŋtinii yettude Alla e reenaade shirk.
Mi jannginii ko fayti e nafoore juulde, e yamirde moƴƴere, e haɗde bonannde.
Mi jeertinii e mawnikinaare e yahde e majjere e dow leydi.
Innde am ina hokka e suura gooto e nder Quraana, ina teeŋtina janngirɗe am.
Wasiya am ina waɗi muñal e caɗeele, sibu ko goonga, ɗuum ummorii ko e geɗe ɓurɗe tiiɗde.

outcome.answer: Hakkilantaagal makko noon winndaama e Quraana

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
